page.overview:
Who is Baernie?

is a half-elf herbalist and druid of the Air Ashari in Zephrah. As an NPC, Baernie is played by Matthew Mercer.

Baernie is a half-elven woman with vibrant brown eyes and blonde hair (like her sisters Leeta and Maeve) that she wears in a pixie cut.

Baernie was born at some point before 813 PD as the daughter of Derrig and Nel. She was one of triplets, having two sisters, Leeta and Maeve, and a younger brother called Will. She eventually became a druid, although she focused on more areas of training, including the herbalist profession.

Circa 837 PD Baernie lost her father and her brother during an attack on Keyleth in Zephrah, since both were part of Keyleth's defense team as the Master of Defense and a member of the Tempest Blades respectively.
